useCase: Replatform the consumer booking site and fare landing pages (Next.js) for peak-sale traffic and faster marketing launches.

evidence: Booking site is already Next.js; frontend team is running a side-by-side POC on Vercel and Netlify.
Black Friday fare sale in 3 weeks is the forcing event for the decision.
Netlify is the incumbent for the marketing site and CTO is anchored on its current pricing.
baseline.nextStep: Run the load test on the fare search pages with Kestrel's platform team.

useCase: Customer onboarding and loan-application frontends; replace an in-house CloudFront + ECS stack.

evidence: Platform engineering team owns a mature Terraform/CloudFront pipeline and prefers to keep building on AWS.
Digital channels GM is frustrated by 2-week release cycles for onboarding flows.
APRA CPS 234 security review is in progress with no blockers raised yet.
baseline.nextStep: Deliver Secure Compute and SSO/SCIM architecture walkthrough to the security architect.

useCase: Customer self-service portal and outage map with real-time data.

evidence: Engineering lead signed off on Vercel after Amplify build times exceeded 20 minutes in the POC.
Outage map served from the edge cut p95 latency from 1.8s to 300ms in testing.
Architecture review board approved Vercel as the frontend platform on 2026-10-14.
baseline.nextStep: Support procurement on the Enterprise order form; plan onboarding for the platform team.

useCase: Quote-and-buy journeys for home and motor insurance.

evidence: Group IT mandated consolidating all workloads on the existing AWS Enterprise Discount Program.
AWS funded a professional-services migration that offset the engineering cost.
Champion (Head of Digital) left the business mid-evaluation.
baseline.nextStep: Keep in touch with the digital team; revisit at the AWS EDP renewal in 2027.

useCase: Shipper and carrier portals across 6 SEA markets with localized content.

evidence: Team is already on AWS and Amplify is the default because of existing Cognito usage.
Localization for 6 markets is slow to ship today; ISR + i18n routing resonated in the demo.
VP Engineering wants a cost comparison before committing.
baseline.nextStep: Share a TCO comparison vs Amplify including build minutes and bandwidth.

useCase: Merchant dashboard and developer docs; AI-assisted support widget.

evidence: CTO chose Vercel for AI SDK + AI Gateway support; Netlify had no equivalent for their support widget.
MAS TRM controls mapped to Vercel's SOC 2 and ISO 27001 reports with no gaps.
Frontend team migrated docs site in a 2-day spike and kept preview deployments.
baseline.nextStep: Finalize Enterprise terms; schedule migration kickoff for the merchant dashboard.

useCase: Headless storefront for festive-season traffic (Diwali/Big Billion-style sale peaks).

evidence: Storefront fell over during last year's festive sale on a self-managed EKS + CloudFront setup.
Platform team believes they can fix it by tuning autoscaling on AWS.
Commerce head wants a decision before the January sale planning freeze.
baseline.nextStep: Run the joint load test simulating 10x festive traffic on the product listing pages.

useCase: Patient appointment booking and telehealth web app.

evidence: Required all patient data and compute in an India region with a signed local hosting attestation.
Amplify was bundled into an existing AWS credits program at near-zero cost.
App is a small SPA with low traffic, so performance was not a differentiator.
baseline.nextStep: None; closed lost. Revisit if they launch the planned consumer health content site.

useCase: Global vehicle configurator and dealer locator across 30 markets.

evidence: Configurator is a heavy 3D experience; current S3/CloudFront setup struggles with personalization.
SI partner has proposed a fully custom AWS build and has strong influence with the IT department.
Digital marketing division owns the budget and wants faster campaign launches.
baseline.nextStep: Workshop with digital marketing and the SI on a Vercel reference architecture.

useCase: News and entertainment sites with high-volume ISR article pages.

evidence: ISR with on-demand revalidation cut article publish-to-live from 8 minutes to under 5 seconds.
Editorial team adopted preview comments during the POC and asked to keep them.
Contract signed 2026-09-30 for a 2-year Enterprise term.
baseline.nextStep: Hand over to customer success; identify expansion into the video platform team.
